query: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS source_pages, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS facts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS mcqs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS options, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS verifications, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0604-0608:%') AS flashcards, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_facts f ON d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id=f.id WHERE f.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_notes n ON d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id=n.id WHERE n.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM public.search_documents d JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608) AS search_documents LIMIT 1; SELECT m.source_page, m.source_question_number, COUNT(o.id) AS option_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.is_correct) AS correct_count FROM public.gk_mcqs m LEFT JOIN public.gk_mcq_options o ON o.mcq_id=m.id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608 GROUP BY m.source_page, m.source_question_number ORDER BY m.source_page, m.source_question_number LIMIT 50; SELECT v.verification_status, COUNT(*) AS verification_count FROM public.fact_verifications v WHERE v.source_page BETWEEN 604 AND 608 GROUP BY v.verification_status ORDER BY v.verification_status LIMIT 10;
